title: Wanted to Love it BUT It leaks!
text: Wanted to Love it BUT It leaks!. So annoyed.  I poured a huge bag of protein powder and the container started leaking all around the place from all around the window of the jars.  I didn't want to lose any more protein powder so I had to add crazy glue around the window.  I regret spending the money on these cannisters.
